Use case: ui-mockup. Refine the attached existing UI mockup, preserving its application identity but SIGNIFICANTLY increasing practical information density. Deliver ONE finished realistic desktop application screen, 16:10 landscape, crisp readable Russian text, not a poster. This is a mockup only, with tiny "МАКЕТ" label in the top bar to distinguish illustrative states from live data.
Identity: "Абаканская ЛСЭ", subtitle "ФГБУ · Минюст России", simple circular "ЛСЭ" mark. Same forest-green #153e25 sidebar and ivory #f7f8f2 / white content, dark text #20372a, green #155c3b actions. Flat professional enterprise UI, no illustrations or gradients. Make it feel like a dense working document.
DENSITY IS ESSENTIAL: sidebar at most 13% of canvas width, top bar only ~40px, expertise number heading ~24px (not a giant 48px headline), tabs ~32px high, body text 13–14px, rows ~38px, section padding 12px. Do not stretch rows/cards to fill the viewport. No large multi-line helper paragraphs, giant empty boxes, nested card stacks or unnecessary duplicate archive links. One green primary next-step action, other actions outlined or text. Reasonable readable contrast and tidy baseline alignment.
Keep existing sidebar modules compactly: "Рабочее место", "Приёмка материалов", "Экспертизы" selected, "Переписка", "Выдача материалов", "Источники журнала", "Отчёт 15.1", "Годовые планы", "Справочники", "Сотрудники", "Учётные записи", "Роли и права", "Настройки".
Compact header: "482/4-1-26", state badge as specified below, user "setup". A slim metadata line: "19.1 · Отдел 4 · Уголовное · Первичная"; second short line "Лалетина О.В. · Поступление 29.10.2026". Existing data only, no new fields. Tabs: "Работа" active, "Дело", "Документы", "Переписка", "Выдача", "История".
Main canvas has work area 70% and document area 30%, separated by thin border. Headers modest, fields/actions close to values. Help explanations through tiny circular ? icons, not permanent paragraphs. Missing factual information and current restrictions remain visible. Distinguish "Загрузить заключение" (result attachment) from "Добавить файл в дело" (general case files); never duplicate two identical upload buttons with different targets. "Изменить" actions are named "Редактировать". No signatures, new approval workflow, invented required fields, payment widgets, charts, percentages, raw UUIDs, implementation language or fake official emblems. "Дата окончания" belongs to result; issuing materials is a separate step. Uploaded filenames/dates in later illustrative states are examples, not claims of real changes.
Render exact readable Cyrillic. No spelling errors, browser chrome, watermark, 3D, perspective, annotations or explanations outside the UI. Keep composition and scale consistent across this mockup set.

It is a focused UI mockup sheet, not two entire desktops: omit the sidebar and large top bar so the small controls remain readable. Match the same forest-green/ivory, thin dividers, 13–14px typography and 12px padding of the compact redesign. Tiny top label "МАКЕТ · состояния карточки". Two equal-width flat panels side by side; preserve existing capabilities only.
LEFT panel title "Приостановлена", number "482/4-1-26", small "19.1 · Отдел 4 · Уголовное". Secondary "Документы" link. Tiny ? next to date/reason. Do NOT show an ordinary active completion button while suspended or imply the pause ended. Values are illustrative for this mockup.
RIGHT panel title "Только просмотр", number "482/4-1-26", badge "В производстве". Clear compact factual notice "Редактирование недоступно для ваших прав." with a ? for details. Compact rows "Исполнитель" / "Лалетина О.В."; "Результат" / "Заключение эксперта"; "Документ" / "Заключение 482.pdf" with allowed "Открыть" action. These are alternative states, not simultaneous facts about the real record. No charts, new roles, approvals, fields, or long permanent explanatory paragraphs. Accurate Cyrillic and obvious state/action hierarchy.
